label: A total holder of an act the held thing could lack presently gives the held thing being
paraphrase: Conclusion: if z totally holds x in r (definition edca52e4-f224-491d-ac45-5816fac1a9fd), x is in act in r and x could lack that act (Lackability.CanLack, definition 56b438a0-7fcc-4dd5-916b-1d2e2162310b), then z presently actualizes x as to being (Holding.ActualizesNow z x esse, the holding relation read at esse). So under the C* support bundle a holder that does not presently actualize the held thing as to being, such as a hook holding a lamp, is not a total holder of the held thing's lackable act: whatever presently actualizes it as to being co-holds that act. It concerns lackable acts only. 'Gives being' here is the holding relation at esse; identifying such a z with a giver of being in the timed sense of the esse-root routes (BeingGiving.GivesAt) would need the converse of clause (c) of the present-moment reading dedc431f-4f04-40e9-b519-3243d1874c18, which is not formulated.
